audit.method: All 394 legacy points treated as untrusted proposals and visually inspected in 11 source-crop sheets; 75 unmatched detector candidates inspected, with focused context comparisons. All close-marker components below 16px inspected together. Legacy 325 duplicates 324; legacy 309 and 369 retained as possible second animals rather than definite points. Added four bedded elk (candidate IDs 106,200,274,417); three other candidate shapes remain unresolved (105,212,404). Whole-frame recall sweep in 12 overlapping regions, with top empty regions screened at half resolution. Context comparisons use elk and vegetation from this same image. This is a proposal-assisted visual audit, not a blind test of legacy labels.
